paper.title_en: Entanglement entropy of fermions in a strange metal
paper.abstract_en: The subsystem-size dependence of ground-state entanglement entropy and its crossover to thermal entropy as a function of temperature are well understood for one-dimensional (1D) gapless systems described by conformal field theory (CFT), and for free fermions with a Fermi surface in any dimension. However, little is known about the entanglement entropy for gapless fermionic systems without quasi-particles, such as a strange metal. Here we study the entanglement entropy of fermions in a solvable large-$N$ 1D lattice model akin to the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (Yukawa SYK) model. In this model, two Fermi points are coupled to scalar bosons via spatially random Yukawa interactions, providing a solvable model of a strange metal when the bosons become critical at a quantum critical point. We exactly compute the second Rényi entropy of fermions in a spatial subregion in this model. Our results unravel crucial role of intra-subregion entanglement between fermionic and bosonic degrees of freedom along with the inter-subregion entanglement in understanding the ground states of such strongly coupled fermion-boson systems. We show that the crossover from thermal entropy to entanglement entropy, is captured by a single scaling ansatz, that collapses the second Rényi entropy of fermions for different subregion sizes and temperatures into a single universal curve. We further show that the universal scaling curve for the critical strange metal is well described by the standard CFT formula, albeit with an effective central charge substantially larger than the non-interacting value.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了奇异金属中的纠缠熵，这是一个与全息凝聚态物理相关的主题，具有理论深度和新颖性，方法严谨，研究结果对理解强关联系统有重要贡献。
decision.title_zh: 奇异金属中费米子的纠缠熵
decision.abstract_zh: 一维（1D）无能隙系统由共形场论（CFT）描述，以及任意维度中具有费米面的自由费米子，其基态纠缠熵对子系统尺寸的依赖以及作为温度函数的向热熵的交叉已经被充分理解。然而，对于没有准粒子的无能隙费米子系统（如奇异金属），人们对纠缠熵知之甚少。在这里，我们研究了类似Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（Yukawa SYK）模型的可解大-N一维晶格模型中费米子的纠缠熵。在该模型中，两个费米点通过空间随机Yukawa相互作用耦合到标量玻色子，当玻色子在量子临界点变得临界时，提供了一个可解的奇异金属模型。我们精确计算了该模型中空间子区域内费米子的第二Rényi熵。我们的结果揭示了子区域内费米子和玻色子自由度之间的纠缠以及子区域间纠缠在理解这种强耦合费米子-玻色子系统基态中的关键作用。我们表明，从热熵到纠缠熵的交叉由一个单一标度假设捕捉，该假设将不同子区域大小和温度下费米子的第二Rényi熵归并为一条单一普适曲线。我们进一步表明，临界奇异金属的普适标度曲线很好地由标准CFT公式描述，尽管其有效中心电荷远大于非相互作用值。
